blocks.x: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation applied to Water, Waste & City Utilities. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

Water and waste utilities run essential services on aging assets and thin margins: leak detection, network telemetry, customer analytics and regulatory evidence. Non-revenue water alone often pays for the entire instrumented program.

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Energy & Utilities level this capability reads as: unit-commitment and flexibility bidding with policy and replay (scheduling decisions at market speed). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Delivery follows the same weekly rhythm on every program of this type. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
